concerns.spots: Reviewers report the patches reduced whiteheads, papules, and large or cystic-type pimples, often within a day or two, including one case draining a large pimple on the back overnight and another clearing a pimple completely by morning; one reviewer's patch never stayed on long enough to judge whether it worked.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers describe faster healing of popped or active breakouts and reduced picking at blemishes thanks to the covering patch, with one noting a large papule cleared up.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports visible redness reduction within one to two hours of application.

aspects.libelle: Falls off overnight or with skincare layered on
Visible results within hours to two days
